        o.opsregistry,
        AVG(ba.bene_feedbackscore) as avg_bene_feedback,

        MAX(f.funds_util_pct) as max_funds_util
    FROM operations o

    LEFT JOIN financials f ON o.opsregistry = f.fin_ops_ref
    GROUP BY o.opsregistry
),
op_cqi AS (
    SELECT 
        ce.coordopsref as opsregistry,
        AVG(ce.report_compliance) as avg_report_compliance,
        AVG(ce.stakeholder_satisf) as avg_stakeholder_satisf,
        AVG(ce.dataqualityvalue) as avg_dataquality
    FROM coordinationandevaluation ce
    GROUP BY ce.coordopsref
)
SELECT 
    r.opsregistry,
    r.avg_bene_feedback,
    r.avg_distequity,
    c.avg_report_compliance,
    c.avg_stakeholder_satisf,
    c.avg_dataquality,
    (0.4 * (SUBSTRING(r.max_funds_util FROM '([0-9.]+)%')::numeric)) + 
    (0.3 * COALESCE(r.avg_bene_feedback, 0) * 10) + 
    (0.3 * COALESCE(r.avg_distequity, 0) * 100) as res_score,
    (COALESCE(c.avg_report_compliance, 0) + 
     (COALESCE(c.avg_stakeholder_satisf, 0) * 20) + 
     (COALESCE(c.avg_dataquality, 0) * 20)) / 3.0 as cqi_score
FROM op_res r
